ctaHeading: Partner with Master Builders Victoria today.
aboutHeading: Decades of Building Excellence in Melbourne
aboutText: Established in 1873, Master Builders Victoria is Melbourne's leading association for the building and construction industry. We represent over 3,000 members across residential, commercial, and civil sectors, offering tailored services, training programs, and policy advocacy. Our commitment to excellence ensures members are equipped with the latest industry insights and networking opportunities, from regional awards to national conferences. Join us to build a stronger future in Victoria's vibrant construction market.
servicesText: Master Builders Victoria provides a range of services to support builders at every stage. From membership benefits and training to industry events and advocacy, we are dedicated to advancing the construction sector in Melbourne and beyond.

services.title: Membership Services
services.desc: Join our association for exclusive benefits, support, and representation in the Victorian building industry.

services.title: Training & Certification
services.desc: Access professional development programs and certification to enhance your skills and compliance.

services.title: Industry Events & Awards
services.desc: Participate in regional and state events, including the prestigious MBV Regional Building Awards.

services.title: Policy & Advocacy
services.desc: Stay informed on building reforms and have your voice heard through our industry collaboration efforts.

services.title: Resources & Advice
services.desc: Utilise our extensive library of e-docs, guides, and expert advice for construction projects.

services.title: Networking Opportunities
services.desc: Connect with builders, suppliers, and industry leaders at MBV Connect events across Victoria.
